exam_facts.note: Handbook physical p9 (printed p9, WHAT TO EXPECT) states the Class D license has three tests (vision screening, written test, driving test), that written-test questions are taken from the manual, and that a failed written test requires waiting at least one day before retesting. Full-text searches for pass/percent/questions/correct/score/fail found no question count, passing score/percent, or time limit anywhere in the 74 pages; all nulls are genuine absences, not imported from memory. The issuer study-hub page describes its own practice test (20 questions), not the official exam, and is not used as an exam fact.
